name: Commerce Features Bento
description: Light diagonal-large 2x2 commerce feature bento with product-UI mocks: Global sales (fulfillment provider list with toggles + a checkout panel), Cart & checkout (a payment/cart node diagram), Omnichannel ready (a sales-channels table with trend badges), and Powerful order management (an actions context menu with a cursor tag + order status cards).
interactions: cards fade up in a staggered diagonal on first view (IntersectionObserver, 600ms wpmn-cfb-up)
cards lift 3px and deepen their shadow on hover (250ms)
prefers-reduced-motion: hover + reveal off, everything rendered in final state
